ms_credentials.title: Microsoft Account — App Credentials
ms_credentials.description: Device code is recommended: enter the Microsoft client ID, then enter the displayed code at Microsoft and sign in. This mode needs no client secret. The previous login with a secret remains available.

data_description.ms_client_secret: Only for login with a secret. Leave empty to retain an existing secret. Device code ignores this field.

ms_auth_url.title: Microsoft Account — Authorize
ms_auth_url.description:
Click the link below to sign in with your personal Microsoft account and grant Contacts access. After authorization you will be redirected back to Home Assistant automatically.

[Authorize Microsoft Account]({auth_url})

google_credentials.title: Google Account — App Credentials
google_credentials.description: Enter the Client ID and Client Secret from your Google Cloud OAuth 2.0 Web application client.

google_auth_url.title: Google Account — Authorize
google_auth_url.description: A browser window will open for you to sign in with your Google account and grant Contacts access. After authorization you will be redirected back to Home Assistant automatically.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authorize Google Account
reauth_confirm.description: Your Google authorization has expired or been revoked. If you replaced the client secret of your Google Cloud OAuth client, enter the new one below. Click Submit to sign in again with your Google account and restore contact sync.

data_description.google_client_secret: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.

reauth_ms_confirm.title: Re-authorize Microsoft Account
reauth_ms_confirm.description: Your Microsoft authorization has expired or been revoked. If you replaced the client secret in your Entra App Registration, enter the new one below. Click Submit to sign in again with your Microsoft account and restore contact sync.

data_description.ms_client_secret: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.

reconfigure.title: Change App Credentials
reconfigure.description: Choose device code to use Microsoft without a secret. Changing the method or client ID requires a new Microsoft sign-in; the existing entry stays active until success. With the same sign-in method, an empty secret field keeps the stored secret. Google sign-in and the contact mapping are preserved.

data_description.ms_client_secret: Only for login with a secret. Leave empty to retain an existing secret. Device code ignores this field.
data_description.google_client_secret: Leave empty to keep the stored secret.

ms_device_failed.title: Retry Microsoft sign-in
ms_device_failed.description: Nothing was saved. Submit to request a new code.

error.ms_auth_failed: Microsoft authorization failed. Check your client credentials and try again.
error.google_auth_failed: Google authorization failed. Check your client credentials and the authorization code.
error.cannot_connect: Unable to connect. Check your credentials and network connection.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.
error.ms_url_failed: Could not build the Microsoft sign-in URL. Check your credentials and the Home Assistant logs.
error.ms_invalid_client: Microsoft rejected the app credentials. For device code, enable public client flows in Entra. For secret login, check the secret. Nothing was saved.
error.google_invalid_client: Google rejected the client credentials. Check the client secret and try again. Nothing was saved.
error.missing_client_id: Client IDs must not be empty.
error.new_client_requires_secret: A changed client ID needs the client secret that belongs to it.
error.ms_device_failed: Microsoft device sign-in failed. Check the app registration and try again.
error.ms_device_expired: The Microsoft code expired. Request a new code.
error.ms_device_cancelled: Microsoft sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was saved.
error.ms_device_account_mismatch: Sign in with the same Microsoft account as before. The contact mapping belongs to that account. Nothing was saved.

abort.ms_auth_timeout: Microsoft authorization timed out. Please restart the setup.
abort.missing_external_url: Home Assistant external URL is not configured. Go to Settings → System → Network and set the Home Assistant URL, then try again.
abort.ms_device_failed: Microsoft device sign-in failed. Check the app registration and try again.
abort.ms_device_expired: The Microsoft code expired. Request a new code.
abort.ms_device_cancelled: Microsoft sign-in was cancelled. Nothing was saved.

progress.ms_device: Open [Microsoft sign-in]({verification_uri}) and enter code **{user_code}**. Sign in with your personal Microsoft account and approve contacts access. This page waits for confirmation. Only complete a login you started for your own Home Assistant.

data.delete_removed: Delete Outlook contacts when removed from Google
data.auto_remove_duplicates: Auto-remove duplicate Outlook contacts during sync (matched by name — destructive)

sync_now.name: Sync Now
sync_now.description: Trigger an immediate contacts delta sync.

full_sync.name: Full Resync
full_sync.description: Run a full reconciliation: adopt existing Outlook contacts on a unique email match, fix drift, reconcile removed contacts, and reset the delta token.
